name: oydodo-skills
description: Ten curated skills for philosophy, independent judgment, uncertain long-term decision navigation, research-oriented reasoning, practical coding, and technical writing.

interface.longDescription: Philosophical foundation; independent judgment; crux-first reasoning; Wayfinder decision maps for uncertain multi-session goals; requirements clarification; plan stress-testing; minimal coding; Chinese technical writing; developer documentation; and English technical editing.
defaultPrompt: Review this decision and challenge its assumptions when necessary.
Choose the decisive factor in this architecture tradeoff.
Write a README that explains why, how, and expected results.
Use Wayfinder to map open decisions, their blockers, and the fog of war in this multi-session project.
